_note: Covered regions. expected_trails is a collapse tripwire, self-baselined: the count this build measured on 13 Nov 2026; the build fails if a region comes in under 50% of it. It is not an independent OSM figure. classics: each name must be found in the region's names.json with a length in len_m (metres), be ranked first by the app's own name search, and have a stored gain within max_err_pct (default 15) of published_ft (one-way headline gain in feet, source given). stored_len_m: range for the stored (stitched) length when it differs from names.json. v1: also publish the frozen old-format copy at trails/ (Washington only). max_err_pct above 15 is a temporary allowance and only goes with a known_bug note; remove both when the stitcher is fixed. Classic left out on purpose: Stawamus Chief (OpenStreetMap has no route or path covering a peak under that name; the peaks are separate spur ways named First, Second and Third Peak Trail, so no trailhead-to-summit gain can be checked). British Columbia's expected_trails (17626) is the count of its first CI build, 14 Nov 2026.

classics.name: Dog Mountain Trails
classics.known_bug: known stitcher bug: chain starts away from the trailhead; remove when the stitcher is fixed
classics.detail: The stitched chain is 6.89 mi, the published loop length, but it dips to river level (the trailhead) mid-chain, adding a 1,128 ft up-and-down leg; trailhead to summit alone is 2,621 ft (-6.4%). Not DEM noise.

classics.name: Eagle Creek Trail
classics.note: Trailhead to Wahtum Lake: 1,500 ft over the first 7 miles plus 2,250 ft over the next 5, per that guide (sources vary).

classics.name: Misery Ridge
classics.note: Loop figure (5.09 mi, 700 ft); other guides give 910 to 1,100 ft for the ridge climb.

classics.name: Grouse Grind
classics.note: Metro Vancouver's brochure: the trail climbs 800 m (2,625 ft). Other guides give 789 to 855 m. The OSM route relation is the Grind itself, about 1.9 km on the map.

classics.name: Garibaldi Lake
classics.note: Trailhead to the lake, one way: 9 km and about 900 m of gain per that guide (others give 810 to 900 m). OSM names the ways 'Garibaldi Lake Trail'.

classics.name: Wedgemount Lake
classics.note: One-way gain to the lake, 1,160 m per that guide (BC Parks' description gives a 1,200 m change over 7 km; other guides 1,220 to 1,250 m). OSM names the trail 'Wedgemount Lake Trail', 5.6 km mapped.
